'''Ryan R''' is credited on 1 [[Players Committee]] [[Virtual cards|Virtual card]] as the originator of the card idea ("Original concept by …").<ref name="labels">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/resources/card_labels.json card_labels.json] in billbisco/swccg-gemp (commit 0bc4377d9): the printed labels of every Players Committee Virtual card, transcribed from the PC's card images. Field definitions: [https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/docs/card_labels.md docs/card_labels.md].</ref> The credited card is in [[Virtual Block 6]], dated 2009 on this wiki. The concept credit also names the event or award the concept came from: PC Volunteer Award 2009 (1 card).
